'''Breshin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] who worked as a [[Geologist/Legends|geologist]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She specialized in recovering powerful [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|lightsaber crystals]]. Breshin had a shop on [[Carrick Station]], where she sold her findings to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] forces.

==Behind the scenes==
Geologist Breshin and her Imperial counterpart, Geologist [[Pajro]], were added to the Republic and Imperial Fleets in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' with Game Update 1.15 on [[March 6]], [[2015]]. Intended as a temporary measure, the two vendors sold a variety of previously-unavailable endgame crystals, and were removed with Game Update 1.2<ref name="1.1.15">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.1.5/362012|text=1.1.5 Patch Notes}}</ref> on [[April 12]].<ref name="1.2">{{TORweb|url=patchnotes/1.2.0/legacy|text=Game Update 1.2: Legacy Patch Notes}}</ref>
